title: Alicia Keys turns Apple's Grand Central in New York into a concert venue at tech giant’s 50th anniversary kickoff | Mint
summary: Alicia Keys surprises commuters and guests at an Apple store in New York with a live performance, marking the start of Apple's 50th anniversary celebrations. Keys plays popular songs on stage amidst the busy transit hub, with CEO Tim Cook present. This event is part of a series of global celebrations recognizing Apple's innovation over five decades, including the introduction of iconic products and services.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to the context of a busy period for Apple amidst announcements of new devices, but the surprise performance adds a positive element to the overall market impact.
